messages.subject: Re: an inquiry on QTL mapping analysis
parts:
Spuriously high peaks from standard interval mapping is a common problem. See Sec 4.2.5 in the R/qtl book; Chapter 4 is available online at http://www.rqtl.org/book/rqtlbook_ch04.pdf

Regarding the other warning and error messages: (I prefer receiving such in plain-text files rather than Word.)

X'X matrix is singular

This means that the X matrix in the regression was over-parameterized; there may be some markers with a missing genotype category.

Didn't converge at pos 31

extended Haley-Knott is an iterative algorithm. The algorithm didn't reach the desired tolerance for convergence within the specified maximum number of iterations.

530 LOD scores <0, set to 0

An approximate algorithm was used to calculate LOD scores, and the calculations gave some negative values, which are not possible.

Error in plot.new() : figure margins too large

You need to make a bigger plot window so that the full plot can fit.

karl
